maya_cs: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

maya_cs: Did renewal prep for Kestrel (contract sent), spoke with legal on special data terms.
maya_cs: Blocker: still seeing intermittent webhook failures for Kestrel's Prod integration, customer reported 502s around 2am PST. They want an ETA.

lee_support: Noted the 502s. I pulled logs, looks like retries piled up around 02:00. Upstream returned 502 for ~3m, then recover. No alert fired because error rate < threshold.

sam_eng: @maya_cs can you paste the webhook id or request ids? I can query the gateway traces.

maya_cs: webhook id: wk_9ff3a, sample request ids: req_20200345, req_20200346. Customer trace attached in their ticket: https://redwood.zendesk.com/ticket/4892 (internal link)

sam_eng: Thanks. I'll check traces and async delivery queue. Quick heads-up: we rolled a small routing tweak to edge yesterday that might change retry timing. Could be related.

diego_se: FYI I started a canary that pins them to dedicated routing for a day (to rule out edge routing). If stable, we can propose a short maintenance window to switch permanently.

maya_cs: Customer wants an ETA before EOD today. Any chance we have a mitigation timeline?

sam_eng: Short term: I can increase retry interval and cap concurrent retries for that org to reduce pressure — 30m estimate to patch and deploy to staging + smoke test.

lee_support: I'll notify Kestrel that we're investigating and plan a precautionary retry cap. Will give them the 30m dev ETA and offer a low-impact maintenance window tonight.

maya_cs: Perfect. Also, quick code review ping: PR #432 in the docs repo updates webhooks troubleshooting steps. @diego_se could you skim? small change.

diego_se: On it, aim to review in the next hour.

incidents_bot: [incident-created] Incident 2020-82 — Kestrel webhook 502 spikes. Incident channel: #inc-2020-82 (auto) :rotating_light:

sam_eng: One more thing — if anyone is blocked on logs, run:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood.internal/traces?request_id=req_20200345"
```

maya_cs: Thanks everyone, I'll update the customer and post the incident link in the ticket.

lee_support: Will follow up after the staging smoke test. :thumbsup:

diego_se: PR reviewed and small comment left. No blocking issues.

sam_eng: Patch deployed to staging, smoke looks good. I'll promote to canary in ~15m and monitor.

maya_cs: ETA to share with customer: 45–60m for next update (canary + monitor).

lee_support: Acknowledged, will tell them.

maya_cs: Thanks team — will circle back once canary green. :sparkles:
